'''Portland View''' is a district in [[Portland]], [[Liberty City (3D Universe)|Liberty City]], in {{III}}, {{A}}, {{LCS}} and briefly in {{SA}}. It borders [[Saint Mark's]] to the north, [[Trenton]] to the south, [[Portland Harbor]] to the east and [[Chinatown (GTA III)|Chinatown]] to the west.

==Description==
Portland View is a mixed-use district that houses the island's civic services, as well as residential and commercial establishments and greenery. Portland's [[Liberty City Police Department (3D Universe)|LCPD]] station and hospital, [[Sweeney General Hospital]], are both located in the center of the district, wedged between commercial and residential buildings to the west, and an undeveloped, hilly plain and a supermarket to the east ([[Supa Save!]] in ''GTA III'' and [[Fidl]] in ''GTA Liberty City Stories''). A disused tunnel leading to [[Harwood]] is situated behind the supermarket.

In [[1998]], the setting of ''GTA Liberty City Stories'', [[Mickey Hamfists]] resides in the district. It is unknown if he still resides there in [[2001]].

==Trivia==
*The building models of the police station and hospital are reused in the games' [[Shoreside Vale]] counterparts (the LCPD police station and [[Hope Medical College]] in [[Pike Creek]]). However, the Hope Medical College building is significantly extended in height (albeit in the [[Beta Content in GTA III|beta version]], it was supposed to be a perfect copy of its Portland counterpart).
*In ''GTA III'', the [[Police Scanner|police dispatch]] refers to this district as "Portland Street", while in ''GTA Advance'', the police dispatch refers to this district as "Portland Bay".
*The official ''Grand Theft Auto III'' website suggests that Portland View was not originally its own district. Some mock police records mention the Portland LCPD station and [[Baillie Station]] to be in [[Trenton]], suggesting that Portland View was added late in development.
